ACTSFROMTHEPASTTWEAKS.mod_title: Acts from the Past: Multiplayer Tweaks
ACTSFROMTHEPASTTWEAKS-PLAY_OTHER_PLAYERS: Play Time Warp Effects from Other Players

When Time Eater forcibly ends someone's turn, a spinning clock will appear on their screen with a sound.
This setting controls what happens on your screen when that happens to another player.
[gold]Everything[/gold]: The clock will appear with audio.
[gold]Visuals[/gold]: The clock will appear, but there will be no audio with it.
[gold]Audio[/gold]: The audio will play, but there will be no clock with it.
[gold]Nothing[/gold]: You will see and hear nothing.
